'''Cleaning Probe X101''' was a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droid]] used in [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Cy Krolo]]'s partner who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] planted a transmitter on the droid to gather information on [[Voontara Fa'athra]], but was killed before he could activate it. Cy Krolo then asked a passerby to infiltrate the palace and activate the droid's transmitter.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cleaning Probe X101 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Unfinished Business" on Hutta.
